title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Be Disciplined and Still Free
caption:
A river without banks isn't free. It's a flood.

The disciplines that look like limits from the outside are what let a man actually move, fast, without wrecking everything around him.

Galatians 5:13: you were called to be free, then don't use that freedom to indulge the flesh. Freedom and self-control were never opposites in Scripture. One makes the other possible.

The structured man can take the risk. The undisciplined one is just managing the wreckage of the last one.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #freedom
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
